d: The Andromeda crew must thwart an invasion from a mysterious enemy.
Trance runs through a series of possible outcomes in order to save the crew from a deadly intruder.
Dylan and the crew rescue the passengers of a doomed High Guard ship.
Beka is called as a character witness for a friend on a planet where lying and deception are punishable crimes.

st: What Happens to a Rev Deferred
d: The crew receives a cry for help from the long lost Rev Bem.
A newly colonized planet of the Commonwealth comes under attack by Pyrian "pyroformers", but when Dylan destroys the machines, the Pyrian fleet arrives to defend its property.
While in command of the Andromeda during the night shift, Harper decides to initiate a little race with a friendly Nietzschean vessel to the nearest slip-point.
The Andromeda gets caught in the middle of a battle between two Nietzschean prides, one of which is the Drago-Kazov. They manage to capture a hostile fighter from the unknown pride.
After exiting a rather turbulent part of slipstream, the Andromeda finds itself in the middle of the Prolon system, an area full of radiation and dangerous materials, including corrosive waste.
Andromeda encounters a group who has secretly been supporting them. Their leader claims to have a connection to the old Commonwealth. When Dylan hears the claims, he starts to have doubts.

st: Day of Judgement, Day of Wrath
d: Tyr leaves the Andromeda while it is in dry-dock for repairs to seek out other survivors of his pride. Dylan and the rest of the crew remain to see off the newest Commonwealth battleship, the Resolution of Hector.

st: Shadows Cast By A Final Salute
d: Tyr makes his move. He has convinced the Nietzscheans he's the genetic reincarnation of Drago Museveni - progenitor of his race.

st: Answers Given to Questions Never Asked
d: The crew must rescue one of the Triumvirate in order to save the Commonwealth.
Dylan must escape two cruel gamblers’ virtual game of death.
Dylan must defeat a false prophet who seeks to usurp power from the Triumvirs.
The crew must stop the maker of the Magog Worldship from unleashing his android army.
Dylan and the crew must stop the Magog from retrieving a weapon that wipes out their enemy’s minds.
The crew assists in the search for escaped prisoners on a new Commonwealth member world. Dylan finds himself playing a role in an ancient prophecy.
In a landmark episode, Captain Dylan Hunt comes up against former crew member, Tyr for possession of a starmap that leads to the Abyss.

st: The World Turns All Around Her
d: The crew must travel through the Route of Ages to confront the Abyss.
